rules.expected: Both states attempted with explicit state, charge/multiplicity and convergence evidence.
Harmonic frequencies, imaginary modes, 0–125 cm−1 scope and matching basis are reported.

The report supplies MAE and maximum absolute deviation for observed pairs when available, and interprets agreement against the source-reported below-3 cm^-1 result without treating that value as a universal pass threshold; use the actual observed matched pairs and physical mode identities; do not require a feature to remain unmatched if supported evidence assigns it. Use the public 0-125 cm^-1 window and declared scaling/normalization. The reference factor 0.9670 is not mandatory for every allowed model. Retain unmatched peaks separately and never count unobserved peaks as zero errors.
The conclusion identifies xanthene redshift and carboxyphenyl blueshift trends, with physical mode-displacement evidence, including mixed modes when present.

binding.comparison: expert semantic comparison Frequency shifts refer to physically matched displacements, not integer labels. Mixed modes and supported exceptions are valid; no universal red/blue direction or strict maximum error below 3 cm-1 is implied.
